observed.movement_tutorial: ThirdPersonCharacterControllerSingleplayer.Move func28178 uses nonzero movement vector (Vector3 equality epsilon squared <1e-10 means zero); if not zero, sets FirstMove=1 when previously0, and sets moveTutorial GameObject inactive each nonzero move. It does not read CompletedTutorial. moveTutorial is a mobile tutorial GO; exact ID in component5003 fields. FirstMove also controls first gameplayStart SDK call; SDK call is not a tutorial stage.
observed.workout_keyboard_split: WorkingOutManager.Update func50065 has two distinct controls. First reads configured Keybind4 to ExitWorkout (alongside Escape). Later reads literal e using InputUnsafeUtility.GetKeyDownString for faster-workout pulse. e is not a GetString fallback. Original key defaults are separately decoded settings evidence.
observed.ui_particle: UIParticle constructor func50071 initializes firstStopTime=-0.15000000596046448f; private speed exists but FixedUpdate does not read it. FixedUpdate func50072 does nothing without targ. With targ, firstStopTime += Time.deltaTime; when >0 set transform.position=Vector3.Lerp(position,targ.position,Time.deltaTime*firstStopTime*12). Uses world position and clamped Vector3.Lerp; no distance-based arrival, destroy or stat mutation in this method. Reusing original component instance would preserve timer because it has no OnEnable reset; pool adaptation must explicitly restore constructor start delay if matching new-instance behavior.
observed.workout_particle_spawn: WorkingOutManager.SpawnParticle func28164 draws two integer Random.Range(-70,70) offsets; instantiate current muscle particle at particleSpawn.position + (randomX,randomY,0), rotation parentCanvas.rotation; set UIParticle.targ to corresponding stat target; set both text fields to +strengthGained; parent to parentCanvas (worldPositionStays default true); schedules Invoke(GainCoin,1f) on WorkingOutManager, but no GainCoin declaration is present anywhere in supplied dump.cs. Do not invent currency mutation to satisfy this unresolved string invocation.
observed.delete: Delete.OnEnable func49859: if turnOffAfterTime, CancelInvoke(TurnOff), delay=time+(randomTime?Random.Range(-.9,.9):0), Invoke(TurnOff,delay). TurnOff func49858 destroys GO when destroy=true, else SetActive(false). Constructor defaults turnOffAfterTime=true.
observed.change_pitch: OnEnable func49881 fills missing AudioSource using GetComponent; when changePitchAtStart randomizes Random.Range(minPitch,maxPitch). FixedUpdate func49880: local next=true; if justStopPlaying && !audio.isPlaying: randomize pitch, next=false, if !dontLoop audio.Play(); finally justStopPlaying=next. dontLoop=true prevents replay but still randomizes when stopped every other fixed tick. No one-shot completion detector beyond this flag.
observed.play_audio_array: PlayAudioArray.PlayAudio func17020: select audios[index], randomize pitch in [minPitch,maxPitch], Play, increment index and wrap to0 at array length. WorkingOutManager.Update embeds equivalent logic for workoutArray. Level0 component4825 supplies actual pitch bounds and audio order in components/audioSources.
observed.audio_play: AudioPlay.PlayAudio1..4 func49924..49921 simply calls assigned AudioSource.Play; pitch and restart behavior are native AudioSource/ChangePitchPerLoop configuration, not extra randomization here.
observed.look_at: LookAtPlayer.Start and Update use Camera.main.transform when cam null; when cam exists Update calls transform.LookAt(cam.position), including vertical component. Exact referenced cam fields and all seven source instances included.
observed.camera_follow: CameraFollow.Update func49887: when targ exists, transform.position=Vector3.Lerp(position,targ.position,Time.deltaTime*accel). camShake/mainCamera serialized refs are not read in this method.
